progressive.rationale: Default starting point: the simplest architecture that works. Choose a heavier axis only when a concrete driver demands it (progressive architecture, ADR-0047).
Modules need independent CI/CD lifecycles and explicit versioned contracts (DM rules), without the operational cost of full microservices.
Multiple autonomous teams plus high, independent scaling justify independently deployable services (each mapped to one bounded context, ADR-0076). Confirm extraction readiness (ADR-0045).

dimensions.rationale: Asynchronous, decoupled integration across modules/services with versioned event contracts.
Cross-domain data products with clear ownership and contracts (not F1).
Bursty, latency-tolerant workloads fit function-per-execution economics within cold-start/cost budgets.
Low-latency or offline-first requirements place execution at the edge with sync strategy.
Governed autonomous agents require token/credential/sandbox budgets and MCP conformance.
